suggestions.fix: `cues.yaml` is not among my inputs, so I could not check sound.md #1 (a one-word intent per beat, music in and out on a named cue) or #3. Please supply it at G2. Suggested intents: change=hush, rule=lure, first jump=wry, decade=tighten, peak=drop (music drops at the fold, not before), back to you=warm. The music should change at or after the bench reveal, not on the nurse's question.

suggestions.quote: the hospital is one set kit (counter, bench, ward) re-lit (animator, round 1)
suggestions.fix: Pick card #8 passes only if this holds. Name the sets: the night ward, the bench and the canteen counter are the one new set, re-lit with `night` and `lamp`; the bus, the office, Mom's kitchen, the pharmacy and the exam hall come from the kit or the last video. List what is new: the hourglass prop with sand that drains by steps, and the aged figures. Cut the exam hall if it threatens the week.

suggestions.quote: while you and your father keep colour
suggestions.fix: cast.md keeps only you, the stranger and the rule device in colour. Papa in colour is a deliberate exception, so state it. Hide the stranger once, as a crimson coat in the hospital corridor, so the colour rule stays readable.

suggestions.quote: One grey eyebrow hair, and the bill is paid.
suggestions.fix: A single hair will not read on a phone. Stage it as an insert close-up on the brow, with a grey brow shape swapping in on the tick. Build ageing as stepped overlays on the existing rig (grey tuft, brow shape, cheek lines) rather than new rigs.

suggestions.quote: the hours peel off your figure as Papa watches
suggestions.fix: Give this a staged beat with the stamped hour-cards peeling off, Papa in the foreground and a worried-brow reaction on him within 2 s. Keep it separate from the peak so the same card-fold device isn't spent twice.

suggestions.quote: The wordless peak: each work-hour card folds into a year and drops off your figure. You and your father on the hospital bench, the same age, and a nurse asks which of you is the patient.
suggestions.fix: This stacks too much into one wordless beat, and the peak holds up to 10 s only while something moves every 2 to 4 s. Stage the peak as the card-fold (3 s), a push-in to the two aged figures on the bench (3 s) and a slow-motion ghost (3 s). Put the nurse's bubble "Which is the patient?" after the peak, with her in the foreground as a blurred over-the-shoulder head.

suggestions.quote: the night ward, Papa asleep behind you, the phone lit with an hourglass and one red button, your hand hovering
suggestions.fix: Set `> MOOD: night` and make the phone the only lit source. Then insert a top-down shot of the bill under the pillow at about 12 s, so the opening changes every 2 to 4 s.

suggestions.quote: Papa holds yesterday's photo of you beside your face, one year apart overnight
suggestions.fix: Stage it side-on as two heads in one frame, with a tag at the split-flap tally ticking to 1. Reuse the photo prop from the kit if it exists. Add a face reaction within 2 s: Papa shocked, then sceptical.

suggestions.quote: Six o'clock, the laptop shut, the bus to the hospital; you sit with him and count nothing.
suggestions.fix: Mirror the opening shot, with the same bench-side framing and `lamp` replacing `night`, and the sand frozen and the colour back in the world. Keep the right third empty for the last 15 s, with the end-card tags on the left two-thirds.

keep.quote: One year from me buys him ten. Good deal.
He's teasing you about the bus pass again. You let him.
each tap drains a measure of sand and greys the world a step
